desc:
Combined Arms is a military flight sandbox with full cockpits, realistic aerodynamics, and carrier operations.
Dogfight other players in team deathmatch or free-roam sandbox mode.

UPDATE:
Added Rafale C & Yak-130

The current aircraft available are:
- F-22A Raptor
- F-15C Eagle
- Eurofighter Typhoon
- Rafale
- Su-57 Felon
- Su-35 Flanker
- F/A-18C Hornet
- F-14D Super Tomcat
- J-10C Firebird
- F-16CM Fighting Falcon
- Yak-44E Hawkeyeski
- F-15 Eagle STOL (Unlockable)
- AV-8B+ Harrier II
- DC-10F Death Contraption
- Yak-130

The game is not in a complete state and is in early access.
We plan to add radar functionality, infantry, ground vehicles, helicopters, naval vessels, nuclear weapons, and much more.
